relevance_note: Case series of HA20 patients carrying TNFAIP3 variants: '17 patients from 6 families with heterozygous likely loss-of-function variants in TNFAIP3 (ACMG class 4–5) were finally included'.
method_note: Read the full Markdown by hand; a short Python script assembled the JSON from my readings (no table was transcribed by script) and checked spans, fields and labels. Individual-level genetic and clinical data are in online supplemental files 1-3, which are NOT in the Markdown; Table 1 is aggregate only (no patient rows or columns). Rows were therefore created only for cohort patients the text names: pt1-pt4 (family 1, re-reported from ref 8) and the seven neuropsychiatric patients p7, p14, p10, pt13, pt15, Pt16, pt17 (labels kept verbatim; the paper mixes 'p' and 'pt'). The other six of the 17 patients are never named and have no rows. Cohort-wide 'all' statements were applied to each named patient: 'All 17 patients were European', heterozygous ACMG class 4-5 likely loss-of-function TNFAIP3 variant, genetically confirmed HA20, and 'none of the patients in our cohort fulfilled the classification criteria for SLE' (excluded, inferred from group statement). No specific variant is attributed to any person or family: the two variant strings printed, 'pArg183Ter' (OTU domain) and a de novo CNV 'deletion of exons 7–9', are unattributed, so cohort variant rows have variant_original_string 'not reported'. Unattributed facts left out: the suicide attempt ('in one case' of Pt16/pt17); which family holds five of the seven neuropsychiatric patients; female sex 12/17; group-level therapies; the family-level CXCL9/10 increase in the ref 8 family. Not inferred: pt1-pt4 lacking neuropsychiatric symptoms (only implied by the list of seven). ADHD 'at 8 years' is an age at ADHD diagnosis, so it went in severity_or_detail, not onset. Neuropsychiatric disorders were not mapped to the checklist item 'central nervous system involvement'. Three previously published patients summarised in the Discussion have their own rows with source_reference_in_review: Duan et al ref 31 (NPSLE; 'de novo' frameshift, inheritance left 'not reported' because no parental testing is described; the CNS checklist item was left 'not reported' because NPSLE is not stated as CNS involvement); ref 32 (T674P, progressive neuroinflammation, baricitinib); ref 36 proband (cutaneous disease; same unspecified TNFAIP3 variant as one family here; the IL36RN variant in that reference's title is not attributed to the proband in the text, so it is left out). No internal contradictions found: the neuropsychiatric diagnoses in the text match Table 1 counts (mood disorders 3 = DMDD + 2 depression; anxiety 2; ADHD 2; pica 1; ODD 1).
